newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks rally after yesterday's drop.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks rally after yesterday's drop.

text.p: The Dow Industrials, led by a rally in shares of Philip Morris Cos Inc, bounced in early trading Friday after a 160-point drop yesterday motivated by fears of an interest rate hike.
Bonds rallied after the release of weaker than expected February economic data, with the long bond up 7/32 to yield 6.94 percent.
Philip Morris, among the big losers on Thursday, bounced 2-3/4 to 128-3/4, adding more than six points to the Dow.
The Dow rose 41 to 6919 while advances led declining issues by about 10 to six.
